capabilities: Widen tables, code blocks, Mermaid and PlantUML diagrams, image embeds, and TaskNotes widgets beyond the reading column
Add horizontal scrolling inside widened block frames
Configure per-block-type widening and maximum wide-content width via settings
Keep widened blocks away from pane edges with viewport side margins
Apply widening in Reading view and Live Preview
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Local-only: the README states it reads no note content, contacts no network service, and collects no analytics. Manual installation instructions are provided.
motivation: Readable line length is good for prose but painful for wide content, so the author wanted wide blocks to be usable without disabling it or making every note full-width.
problem: Obsidian's readable line length squeezes, clips, or wraps wide material like tables, diagrams, and long code blocks.

relations.evidence: TaskNotes widgets (such as relationship Kanban boards)

summary: Wide-content layout plugin that lets tables, diagrams, images, and code blocks break out of the readable line length into scrollable wide frames.
